font_families.font_family_cn: Android platform SansSerif; Android OS resolves CJK by script and locale, with no vendor-specific face pinned.
font_families.font_family_digits: Android platform SansSerif; no tabular-digit face is declared.
font_families.license: No app-bundled font or repository-level font license artifact exists. The mapped face is supplied by Android; the repository does not pin a vendor face or redistribute a font.
font_families.fallback: Android OS script/locale-aware fallback for CJK and other missing glyphs; exact vendor face is intentionally not pinned.
font_families.portability: Android-specific mapping; other renderers require an explicit platform mapping and cannot infer a font from a screenshot.
font_families.resolution_scope: Ordinary Chinese, English and numeric UI text only; this does not resolve the calligraphic brand role.

allowed: Brand Hero may refer only to an approved brand font source or existing frozen brand artwork; no new family is inferred.
Fish Species Name may use its registered page size/line-height while retaining the shared family and weight catalog.
Large Statistic may use the registered Normal Home Font A reference-pixel mapping, which converts to sp and continues to honor OS fontScale.
forbidden: Page-private font family or unregistered fallback.
Page-defined private size scale outside a referenced page authority.
Silent text shrink, canceled fontScale, unregistered letter spacing, or color literals.
override_policy.shared_family_change_requires: Explicit owner decision D-007; do not replace a frozen page visual.

page_overrides.rule: For frozen brand lettering, prefer the original approved visual asset. Normal Home currently renders 渔见 as dynamic text; Core Visual specifies a calligraphic brand role, while the current runtime maps SansSerif. No approved dynamic brand font source/license or replacement asset is registered. Keep this conflict open; do not infer from a screenshot, download a font, or change the frozen visual/runtime.
Page authority may set size and line-height for species hierarchy; family and weight remain in shared catalog; preserve page authority.
Use Normal Home Font A reference-pixel mapping and its explicit width/density conversion to sp. Keep source values page-scoped; OS fontScale remains enabled.
Use the registered centered-title exception and state-specific result contract; do not promote its geometry to a global navigation variant.
The frozen visual and copy are authoritative. Reuse the approved original brand artwork when available; do not infer a typeface from the Frozen PNG. This does not authorize a page-private family.

page_audit.finding: Frozen brand copy and artwork remain authoritative; no font may be inferred from the PNG. Existing shared role names a calligraphic brand role, but no named source/license is registered.

Font A reference-pixel sizes use the registered width/density conversion and OS fontScale. The 渔见 wordmark is dynamic text mapped to SansSerif while brand intent is calligraphic; source/asset approval remains open.
Centered title and state-specific result typography remain page authorities.
Shared family with page-scoped media text / ON_MEDIA color roles; A/B Frozen visuals remain authoritative.
Species title sizing is page-owned; large text grows its container and keeps semantic order.

tracking_rule: 0sp unless a page/component authority registers a specific override.
font_scale_rule: Honor Android OS fontScale; expand containers and scroll when needed; never silently shrink or cancel scaling.
